candidate_sentences.text: Infortar Group reported significant improvements in profitability for the first half of 2026, despite a decline in total revenue.
The group’s consolidated revenue decreased by 0.6% to EUR 945.9 million, down from EUR 951.9 million in the same period of 2025.
However, the group’s operational performance improved markedly.
EBITDA increased by 30.8% to EUR 111.2 million, up from EUR 85.1 million in the first half of 2025.
Operating profit, or EBIT, nearly doubled, rising by 93.5% to EUR 51.1 million from EUR 26.4 million.
Cash and cash equivalents rose to EUR 253.2 million, reflecting effective cash flow management and the maintenance of a liquidity buffer to finance new investments.
The group invested approximately EUR 50 million in the first half of the year, including EUR 7.3 million in the maritime transport segment.

verified_key_information_units.information: H1 2026 segment EBITDA was EUR 39.3 million for maritime transport (vs EUR 33.3 million in H1 2025), EUR 59.9 million for energy (vs EUR 51.7 million), and EUR 6.5 million for real estate (vs EUR 4.4 million). Supporting segments contributed EBITDA of EUR 5.6 million, improving from a loss of EUR -4.4 million in H1 2025.

candidate_sentences.text: This turnaround was supported by stronger performance across the energy segment, the addition of new agricultural units, and the closure of unprofitable operations.
The most significant improvement occurred in the supporting businesses segment, which shifted from a loss of EUR 4.4 million to a profit of EUR 5.6 million in EBITDA terms.

verified_key_information_units.information: In Q2 2026, Tallink Grupp carried 1,454,725 passengers (-2.2% YoY), 68,986 cargo units (+2.9%), and 199,025 passenger vehicles (-6.5%). The segment reported a net loss of EUR 2.5 million (unchanged YoY), impacted by higher fuel costs (up EUR 8.4 million vs Q2 2025), full EU ETS emissions surrender (100% of CO2 equivalent vs 70% in 2025), and the 36-month charter of the Superfast IX vessel from May 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: Maritime transport business segment (I7)

candidate_sentences.text: In the maritime transport segment, revenue remained stable at EUR 207.0 million in the second quarter, unchanged from the prior year.
However, EBITDA declined slightly to EUR 34.3 million from EUR 37.4 million.
The segment faced headwinds from heightened geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, which increased fuel costs by EUR 8.4 million year-on-year.
Additionally, the share of emissions to be surrendered under the EU Emissions Trading System increased to 100% in 2026.
Passenger numbers decreased by 2.2% to 1,454,725, while cargo units increased by 2.9%.

verified_key_information_units.information: Elenger Grupp's Q2 2026 gas and electricity sales volumes decreased by 34% to 3.3 TWh (from 4.9 TWh in Q2 2025), primarily due to reduced wholesale sales. The segment held a 29% market share in the Finnish-Baltic gas market. During Q2, Elenger continued developing battery energy storage systems, with a 4.5 MW facility in Liepāja, Latvia entering commercial operation at the start of Q3 2026. Polish subsidiaries secured a EUR 60 million loan agreement to expand the Polish gas business.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: Energy business segment (I7-I8)

candidate_sentences.text: This reduction was primarily driven by the energy segment, where Elenger Grupp’s gas and electricity sales volumes fell by 34% to 3.3 TWh, largely due to a decrease in wholesale sales.
The energy segment’s revenue dropped significantly in the second quarter due to lower consumption and wholesale sales, with natural gas consumption in the Finnish-Baltic region falling by 7%.

Despite this, the energy segment contributed to the overall EBITDA growth through improved operational efficiency and the stabilization provided by network operations, which are less seasonal than trading activities.
